name: selran
description: Selran plugins — developer methodology and design tools by Selran. Greenloop: the convergent audit/fix loop that runs until green. Design Director: high-quality visual work with AI-slop blocked.

plugins.name: greenloop
plugins.description: Selran Greenloop — five skills that drive a codebase to convergence: codemap (cartographer), runtime-aware verification (pre-commit-verification), spec reconstruction with intent interview (spec-bootstrap), ten-category convergent audit (app-audit), and baseline-aware remediation with adversarial re-verification (audit-fix). Free for personal, non-commercial use.

plugins.name: design-director
plugins.description: Selran Design Director — direct high-quality visual work from Claude: pick one of seven rendered design directions, get a portable design-system.md, and have it enforced across websites, apps, native mobile, documents, and decks — dark mode, accessibility audits, i18n, performance budgets — while generic AI-slop defaults are blocked. MIT core; independently licensed add-on packs.
